title: List of episodes
summary: The following is a list of episodes for the animated television series, Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The first season premiered on January 3, 2009, in both the UK and the US. The second season premiered in Italy on September 17, 2011, before airing in the UK on April 16, 2012, and in the US on April 21, 2013.

full_text:
The following is a list of episodes for the animated television series, Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The first season premiered on January 3, 2009, in both the UK and the US. The second season premiered in Italy on September 17, 2011, before airing in the UK on April 16, 2012, and in the US on April 21, 2013.
